sources.title: Alien Amplification Origami Overdrive | Effects Database
sources.excerpt: Effects Database lists Origami Overdrive as a low-gain overdrive. The model was published in the database on August 3, 2014 and the page retains multiple manufacturer and third-party demonstration references, including an Origami v.2 demonstration.
